title: Sources: SpaceX and Tesla are progressing in their merger negotiations and could announce a deal as soon as December or early 2027 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: SpaceX and Tesla are progressing in their merger negotiations and could announce a deal as soon as December or early 2027 — SpaceX and Tesla Inc. are progressing in their merger negotiations, setting the stage for a combination that could redefine the limits of global dealmaking.
